questions.question: Why did Abram and Lot decide to separate?
options: Lot wished to return to live in Egypt
Abram was commanded by God to send him away
The land could not support them both
Famine had struck the whole region of Canaan
questions.answer: The land could not support them both

questions.question: Which land did Lot choose for himself?
options: The dry land of the Negev
